primary_objective: Land on the pad at (0,0) with legs in contact, minimizing time and fuel use.
objective_decomposition: Phase 1: Stabilize and descend toward pad using main engine and orientation control.
Phase 2: Fine-tune horizontal position and vertical velocity near pad.
Phase 3: Soft landing with both legs contacting pad, minimal residual velocity.
behavior_trajectory_alignment: Phase 1: Stabilize and descend toward pad using main engine and orientation control.
Phase 2: Fine-tune horizontal position and vertical velocity near pad.
Phase 3: Soft landing with both legs contacting pad, minimal residual velocity.
metric_priority: Average return (cumulative reward) over evaluation episodes, with emphasis on successful landing rate.
primary_selection_metric: Average return (cumulative reward) over evaluation episodes, with emphasis on successful landing rate.
proxy_metrics: Distance to pad at episode end.
Fuel consumption (integral of m_power and s_power).
success_criteria: Both legs in contact with ground (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1).
Position near (0,0) (state[0] and state[1] close to 0).
Low linear and angular velocities at landing.
Episode termination due to landing (not crash/out-of-bounds).
failure_modes: Hovering indefinitely without landing (avoids crash but never succeeds).
Landing far from pad (still gets leg contact but misses primary objective).
Excessive fuel use due to inefficient engine firing patterns.
Over-reliance on orientation engines causing oscillation.
bad_local_optima: Hovering indefinitely without landing (avoids crash but never succeeds).
Landing far from pad (still gets leg contact but misses primary objective).
Excessive fuel use due to inefficient engine firing patterns.
Over-reliance on orientation engines causing oscillation.
reward_generator_constraints: Reward must be a scalar float returned by compute_reward.
Must use state, m_power, s_power, terminated as inputs.
Should encourage fast landing with minimal fuel while penalizing crashes and inefficiency.
Avoid sparse reward: provide shaping for progress toward pad and stable descent.
Keep regularizers mild to avoid discouraging necessary engine use.
